metadata.screenshotReview: Individual inspection of every 1231x768 first-viewport and full-page screenshot pair; contact sheets were not used as scoring evidence.
limitations: Fixture data is evaluated only for geometry.
Automated proxies do not replace individual human review.
Screenshot edge density is explicitly N/A.
WCAG 1.4.12 requires a separate text-spacing override survival test.

formula.hardCap: Human-confirmed first-viewport overlap, unclamped clipping, essential contrast failure or document-level overflow caps UDS at 49.

pages.title: Security Operations Overview
pages.visualFinding: Readable KPI and queue structure, but an oversized title band delays operational content.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Reduce shared PageFrame header height and trailing space.

pages.title: Executive Wallboard
pages.visualFinding: A large narrative hero dominates the first viewport and pushes analytical evidence down.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Compress the executive hero and surface the first decision/data panel above the fold.

pages.title: Platform Health
pages.visualFinding: Dependency and recovery content is dense but readable; the control row is close to its right boundary.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Allow the filter row to wrap at the 1200–1231px breakpoint.

pages.title: Incidents & Cases
pages.visualFinding: The three-column layout overflows horizontally and unequal column heights create a large blank full-page region.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Stack the decision rail below 1280px and add min-width:0/overflow containment to every column.
pages.hardCap: Right decision column is clipped in the first viewport.

pages.title: Alert Queue
pages.visualFinding: Queue hierarchy, row spacing and the downstream detail sequence are consistently readable.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Use this page as a queue/table spacing reference.

pages.title: Response Actions
pages.visualFinding: The right state column is clipped and narrow cards force awkward title/value wrapping.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Replace the rigid multi-column grid with responsive EuiFlexGrid breakpoints and min-width:0.
pages.hardCap: Authoritative-state content is clipped at the right edge.

pages.title: Event Search & Hunt
pages.visualFinding: Dates and action identifiers wrap excessively, inflating row height and slowing comparison.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Set intentional table column widths and nowrap/ellipsis for identifiers and timestamps.

pages.title: Asset Inventory
pages.visualFinding: Multiple inventory columns overlap, so rows cannot be parsed reliably.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Use an owned horizontal table scroller, explicit column minima and non-overlapping cell content.
pages.hardCap: Site, owner and lifecycle table text visibly collides or concatenates.

pages.title: Vulnerability Exposure
pages.visualFinding: The exposure-trend panel is mostly blank; exact evidence appears far below its heading.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Render a compact chart or collapse the empty plot height and keep exact values adjacent.

pages.title: Vulnerability Matches
pages.visualFinding: The match table is structured and readable; yellow review controls need contrast verification.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Verify EUI warning-button text contrast and retain the present table geometry.

pages.title: Remediation Queue
pages.visualFinding: Summary, queue rows and status geometry remain coherent throughout the long page.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Use this page as a remediation-queue reference.

pages.title: Asset 360
pages.visualFinding: Entity header, tabs and evidence cards form a clear scan path with stable spacing.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Use this entity-detail composition as a reference pattern.

pages.title: ITSM Overview
pages.visualFinding: The overview is balanced and readable; review-state contrast and header height remain minor concerns.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Tighten the shared title band and verify warning-state contrast.

pages.title: Work Queues
pages.visualFinding: A mostly empty saved-views panel precedes a dense long queue, producing a sparse/dense discontinuity.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Convert saved views to a compact toolbar or populate it with useful saved-view rows.

pages.title: Requests & Service Catalog
pages.visualFinding: Catalog and request detail form a readable two-column workflow; only the active sidebar label wraps.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Allow the navigation label a stable two-line height without compressing the page content.

pages.title: Incident Management
pages.visualFinding: The main queue appears empty while the detail surface merges labels and values into unreadable lines.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Restore queue rows and use EuiDescriptionList/grid gaps for incident detail fields.
pages.hardCap: Primary incident queue renders headers without rows and detail labels concatenate with values.

pages.title: Problem Management
pages.visualFinding: Recurrence cards are cramped while the overall multi-column page contains large unused regions.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Widen or stack recurrence cards and decouple governance placement from the tallest column.

pages.title: Change Management
pages.visualFinding: The calendar is dense but usable; coral review actions have weak visual contrast.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Use an EUI semantic warning/danger treatment with verified text contrast.

pages.title: Approvals & Tasks
pages.visualFinding: Queue rows, detail and actions remain clear across the full page.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Retain as an approvals/table reference.

pages.title: ITSM Analytics
pages.visualFinding: Controls, chart and exact-value table are well grouped; chart labels are the only small-text concern.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Increase chart-label minimum size while retaining the current structure.

pages.title: Reports & Exports
pages.visualFinding: The export table is readable, but a narrow template rail causes repeated title wrapping.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Give the template rail a larger minimum width or stack it at the audit breakpoint.

pages.title: ITSM Settings
pages.visualFinding: The configuration rail truncates its search placeholder; the main diff/detail surfaces remain structured.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Increase the rail input width and apply min-width:0 plus intentional ellipsis.

pages.title: Copilot Workspace
pages.visualFinding: All three Copilot columns are locally crowded, with broken session labels and isolated numeric fragments.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Widen/stack the session rail and tool context; normalize message block spacing and line boxes.
pages.hardCap: Session labels and message fragments visibly concatenate or break into unreadable pieces.

pages.title: Agent Fleet
pages.visualFinding: A narrow fleet grid makes IDs, versions and capacity values difficult to compare and greatly inflates page height.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Switch to a responsive table/list or wider cards with protected identifier columns.
pages.hardCap: Agent identifiers and comparison fields break across many single-word or single-token lines.

pages.title: Task Dispatch
pages.visualFinding: Task names break vertically, state steps concatenate, receipts crowd, and the right side is clipped.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Replace the fixed three-column dispatcher with breakpoint stacking and explicit overflow ownership.
pages.hardCap: Document-level overflow, clipped controls and multiple text collisions are visible.

pages.title: Agent Runtime Access
pages.visualFinding: Runtime-policy risk values truncate to fragments such as Criti, preventing reliable scanning.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Set a minimum Risk column width and move overflow to an owned grid/table container.
pages.hardCap: The essential Risk heading and values are clipped.

pages.title: Runtime Catalog Overview
pages.visualFinding: The overview is readable, but detail metadata and dependency tags concatenate into one line.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Render dependency metadata as a wrapping EuiFlexGroup/EuiBadge list with explicit gaps.

pages.title: Data Sources & Integrations
pages.visualFinding: The integration layout exceeds the viewport and compresses all remaining columns.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Stack the third panel below 1280px and enforce min-width:0 on grid children.
pages.hardCap: Document-level horizontal overflow clips the CTA, third panel and detail content.

pages.title: Detection Rules
pages.visualFinding: Rule list, editor and coverage detail create a clear authoring scan path.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Use this page as an authoring-workbench reference.

pages.title: Event Schemas & Contracts
pages.visualFinding: Schema tree, detail, code and compatibility sections remain readable and well grouped.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Use this page as a schema/workbench reference.

pages.title: Runtime Objects
pages.visualFinding: The object table loses its final column even though the adjacent detail card remains clear.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Give the object table owned horizontal scrolling and preserve every column header/value.
pages.hardCap: The table's rightmost essential column is clipped.

pages.title: Script Workbench
pages.visualFinding: Library, editor, inputs and outputs form a strong workbench despite the expected tall code surface.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Retain as a script-workbench reference.

pages.title: Knowledge Sources
pages.visualFinding: Some source and freshness fields wrap, but the table and coverage detail remain understandable.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Protect source/freshness columns with minimum widths and intentional truncation.

pages.title: Playbooks & Automation Templates
pages.visualFinding: The graph/workbench is well grouped and the narrow list remains usable.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Retain the present workbench structure; verify list width at 1200px.

pages.title: Detection Notes
pages.visualFinding: The right side extends off-screen and the full page has a massive blank canvas beside a long note list.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Remove fixed widths, stack the detail panel, and avoid tying page height to an empty sibling column.
pages.hardCap: Right detail and create control are clipped by document-level overflow.

pages.title: Response Projects
pages.visualFinding: The master/detail composition is readable with only moderate column-height imbalance.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Allow the detail panel to become sticky or collapse after its content ends.

pages.title: Users
pages.visualFinding: The user table is readable, but a short fixed detail panel leaves most of the full page blank beside 16 rows.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Use a sticky detail panel or full-width lifecycle section and verify final-column containment.

pages.title: Roles
pages.visualFinding: Role catalog and capability matrix fit the viewport with clear compact controls.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Retain as a settings/catalog reference.

pages.title: Permissions
pages.visualFinding: The query form and long results table are consistently spaced and easy to scan.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Retain as a dense permissions-table reference.

pages.title: Platform Settings Directory
pages.visualFinding: Clear hierarchy, but a single setting occupies a large surface and produces low useful density.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Use a compact setting row/list or reduce the empty detail-panel height.

pages.title: Authentication / LDAP / SSO
pages.visualFinding: Realm chains, provider table and health detail are grouped into a clear operational sequence.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Retain as an authentication/settings reference.

pages.title: Theme & Accessibility
pages.visualFinding: Theme catalog and preview/validation area are coherent; compact metadata remains readable.
pages.topCodeFacingCorrection: Retain the structure and continue validating high-contrast/reduced-motion states.
